text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- U.S. Under-Secretary for State for African Affairs, George Moose, said Angola had reached the final stage in its peace process and it was important that both the government and its former war rival UNITA moved forward in achieving lasting peace.

- Mozambique President Joaquim Chissano said in an interview that after a meeting of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) he believed there were solutions to break the stalemate in Angola's peace process.
- A delegation from the World Bank and the IMF are due to visit Angola at the end of October to review progress in the government's plan to restructure the economy.
